errors.text_span: 图表采用堆叠柱状图形式
errors.evidence: The chart is not a stacked bar chart. It is a diverging bar chart where two sets of bars extend in opposite directions (positive and negative) from a common baseline (y=0). In a stacked chart, bars are placed on top of each other.

errors.text_span: 每个柱状图由上下两部分堆叠构成
errors.evidence: This reinforces the incorrect description of the chart as 'stacked'. The bars are not stacked on top of each other; they are two separate bars per category, one extending upwards from zero and the other extending downwards from zero.

errors.text_span: 各柱状图高度随标签类别递减
errors.evidence: The term '高度' (height) is ambiguous. It is not specified whether this refers to the positive bars (古汉比例), the negative bars (现汉比例), or the total visual span of both. While the decreasing trend is true for all interpretations in this case, the language lacks precision.
